Tudor · ref. M7941A1A0RU

Black Bay 58

Dive · 39mm · 200m (660 ft) · automatic · 2018–2024

The Black Bay 58 is a vintage-inspired dive watch that pays homage to Tudor's first divers' watch from 1958, the reference 7924. It is defined by its more compact 39mm case diameter, characteristic of 1950s proportions, and signature design cues like the 'snowflake' hands.

The story

The Black Bay 58 was introduced in 2018 as a smaller, more historically accurate version of the popular Black Bay, capturing the essence of the brand's mid-century dive watches. The initial model featured a black dial with gilt accents, followed by a navy blue version in 2020. The family has since expanded to include models in precious metals and bronze, such as the 925 silver with a taupe dial, an 18k yellow gold version with a green dial, and a boutique-exclusive bronze model. A significant recent development is the introduction of a GMT model, further broadening the family's appeal.
